summary: The earlier sign-in's unused code is removed, and every failed run carries a support code.

fixes.title: Unused sign-in code removed
fixes.text: The code of the earlier sign-in, unused since Microsoft's built-in sign-in took over, is gone from the install and the update. Your installation is not changed.

fixes.title: A support code on every failed run
fixes.text: A job run that does not end OK now names a stable code, so Invardia support can tell you the cause and the next step without reading logs.

fixes.title: Corrected help pages
fixes.text: The install and security pages describe Microsoft's built-in sign-in, and the tamper monitor page says when an accepted change closes.
